title: Bunny Baby Bodysuit, Pink Rabbits and Flowers Baby Outfit, Organic Cotton Long Sleeve, Baby Girl Gift, Baby Shower Gift
description:
Cream bunnies hopping among pink flowers, berries and little hearts. A soft, cheerful print for the first months.

A lovely baby shower or new baby gift, perfect for everyday cuddles, Easter and first photos.

DETAILS
- 100% certified organic cotton, gentle on sensitive skin
- Long sleeves, envelope neckline for easy dressing
- Poppers at the crotch for quick changes
- Sizes: Newborn (0-3M), 3-6M, 6-12M, 12-18M
- Colour: White, small motifs printed across the front

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out. Do not tumble dry on high heat. Do not iron directly on the print.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the EU (Germany) and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships within Europe and the UK.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
